gini_empty_blocks_before_inventory:
The evenness (Gini) stage removed all 1 candidates. Every one of them binds the target fewer than min_gini_sites (3) times across both strands, so their spacing is not measurable.
On a small target this is expected. Either lower the threshold, with "min_gini_sites": 1 in params.json or --min-gini-sites 1 on neoswga filter, which accepts single-site primers and their unmeasurable evenness; or admit more abundant k-mers by lowering min_k, raising max_bg_freq, or lowering min_fg_freq.
